newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up on a record volume of trade.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up on a record volume of trade.

text.p: Dhaka shares closed up as most blue chips gained on a record volume amid buying by both small and institutional investors, brokers said.
"There was a rush of fresh funds and commitments. It started slow but short covering by investors later on mainly blue chips pushed the market up," said one broker.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index rose 20.04 points or 1.24 percent on a turnover of 246.9 million taka. Of the 107 issues traded, 56 closed up, 48 ended down and three were unchanged. Apex Foods gained 214.65 taka to 6,360.36 and Bangladesh Tobacco Company rose 14.36 to 252.29.
